{{Quote|Sir, we have intruders in the detention area.|The droid alerting Sib Canay|<ref name="Sphere of Influence">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref>}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this '''battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Unidentified Lucrehulk-class battleship (Pantora)/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship]].

==Biography==
When [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]] infiltrated the Trade Federation ''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship in search for Chairman [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|N. Papanoida's]] kidnapped daughters, the droid tracked the two as they were moving through the ship's detention area and informed [[Sib Canay/Legends|Sib Canay]] of their presence.

==Behind the scenes==
The B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].
